explanation: Calculates the total fair value for both prior and current schedules across all holdings in the holdings table and computes the difference.
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN period_role = 'prior' THEN fair_value END) AS prior_fair_value, SUM(CASE WHEN period_role = 'current' THEN fair_value END) AS current_fair_value, SUM(CASE WHEN period_role = 'current' THEN fair_value ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period_role = 'prior' THEN fair_value ELSE 0 END) AS change_in_fair_value FROM holdings
